precedence: original method and public author code where 2021 is silent
disclosed project settings selected on validation only

split.origin: Project split retained for comparability; NOT specified by the 2021 paper

evaluation.matching: closest valid prediction-truth edge first; deterministic one-to-one
evaluation.duplicate_predictions: each unused prediction counts FP, including equal coordinates
evaluation.aggregation: sum TP/FP/FN over files, then F1; project supplement
evaluation.overlap_conflict: distance then prediction coordinate then truth coordinate; project supplement

rulsif.fixed_claim: 2021 section 4.2 lambda=.01; window fixed from completed validation selection
rulsif.adapters: n=W, k10, demo alpha=.01, boundary coordinate, local peaks and validation threshold are supplements; no extra NMS

floss.fixed_claim: 2021 section 4.2 z-normalized Euclidean; section 4.4 window searched
floss.adapters: buffer800 is short-file adaptation; k3 and inclusive +/-5m follow public example; original scale before noise; seed0

tscp2.fixed_claim: 2 TCN stacks,64 filters,kernel4,dilations1/4/16,three-layer ReLU/BN head,per-pair InfoNCE,previous W similarity means and local peaks
tscp2.adapters: PyTorch port; projection-output BN; training-phase BN updates statistics; inference uses running statistics; precise winning-run mode unpublished; stride5; 2W separation; source training-loss early stopping; validation peak threshold; no extra NMS
tscp2.early_stopping: after epoch6, four consecutive loss increases or changes<.0001; keep final checkpoint
tscp2.training_budget_origin: source stopping and 1600-epoch cap, not a stated 2021 fixed budget

test_use_disclosure: Previously viewed test data; this search is validation-only, not a new blind test

baseline_origin.selection: completed independent project grid; validation event micro-F1, precision, fewer FP, candidate ID, higher threshold
baseline_origin.mode: fixed per-margin parameters and thresholds; no runtime selection or training
